description: This source file defines the TransactionManagerExtension class, which implements the ITransactionManagerExtension interface within the Orleans.Transactions namespace. The class manages transaction-related operations such as pinging, preparing, and committing transactions by delegating to transaction managers associated with resource identifiers.

classes.name: TransactionManagerExtension
classes.description: Implements transaction management extension methods to handle transaction lifecycle events for resources, delegating to appropriate transaction manager instances.

methods.name: TransactionManagerExtension
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transaction manager extension with context accessor and resource manager registry.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a ping operation on a specified resource and transaction.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction involving specified resources.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Marks a transaction as prepared for a specific resource.

methods.name: GetManager
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an ITransactionManager instance for a given resource ID.
